name: Elisha
bio: Elisha son of Shaphat, of Abel Meholah, was named by the LORD at Horeb as the prophet who would succeed Elijah (1 Kings 19:15-16). Elijah found him plowing with twelve yoke of oxen, working the twelfth pair himself, and threw his cloak over him without a word. Elisha ran after Elijah asking only to first kiss his father and mother goodbye; Elijah's reply — "Go back again: for what have I done to thee?" — left the choice entirely his own. Elisha then slaughtered his own yoke of oxen, burned the plowing equipment to cook the meat, and gave it to the people to eat — a decisive break with his old life — before leaving to become Elijah's attendant (1 Kings 19:19-21). His far more extensive ministry as Elijah's successor is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
